name: @gotong/example-atong-longrun
description: LONG-M6 capstone — the long-run lane end to end with a deliberately amnesiac model: reception → start_longrun_task → segment relay over the on-disk dossier (every segment is a cold start: one user message, zero carried conversation); a park record round-tripped through JSON, the process 'killed' and a fresh store + agent resumed over the same directory; a mid-segment provider crash that honestly stops the chain and a re-dispatch that surfaces the ⚠ interrupted line; a token budget that runs out and forces a synthesizer-slot wind-down segment with an honest partial delivery; and a fan-out of three child tasks whose results are written into the parent dossier by driver code (one child 'offline' → the black-hole fact row). Deterministic, no network, no API key, no LLM.
